status_definitions.implemented: The stated bounded software behavior is present and has named evidence; not full product or financial qualification.
status_definitions.experiment: Runnable experimental code has bounded engineering evidence; no deployment or performance benefit is implied.
status_definitions.partial: A useful implementation or specification exists, with a concrete remaining integration or qualification condition.
status_definitions.external: The named acceptance requires an external environment, evidence or a future experiment; the parent patch cannot establish it.

items.title: Durable reference run bridge with leased completion

subitems.concrete_outcome: Persist a stable idempotent experiment and launch intent before spawning the existing managed worker.
acceptance_evidence: Initial combined O13 suite: 8 passed, including restart/idempotency and launch uncertainty; actual HTTP repeat returns the same run without another spawn.
subitems.remaining_condition: A launch whose identity is uncertain remains unresolved; the caller must inspect it instead of automatically retrying.

subitems.concrete_outcome: Use an exact experiment-ID claim with existing owner/revision/lease CAS, heartbeat and one-attempt limits.
acceptance_evidence: Tests prove an unrelated higher-priority record remains pending and an expired lease cannot publish its candidate.
subitems.remaining_condition: General training/paper jobs require their own bounded model/configuration/account contract before joining this bridge.

subitems.concrete_outcome: Run a fixed 96-bar synthetic reference through the existing Playground engine under a process watchdog.
acceptance_evidence: The real fixture subprocess completed through the HTTP/supervisor integration test; deterministic reference replay is asserted.
subitems.remaining_condition: The fixture is not an independent persistent paper account or strategy qualification; no market download or financial authority is added.

subitems.concrete_outcome: Publish artifact digest only after successful leased completion and verify exactly the bytes later parsed.
acceptance_evidence: Tests reject corrupted artifacts and leave a written-but-uncompleted candidate unpublished; actual local HTTP fetch validated the completed artifact.
subitems.remaining_condition: Power-loss/fsync schedules and remote/object-storage publication have not been qualified.

subitems.concrete_outcome: Keep worker audit events in the existing atomic outbox and let the API reconcile signing/delivery credentials.
acceptance_evidence: Actual local HTTP integration test verified sealed outbox reconciliation; worker environment does not receive gateway/provider/broker/audit keys.
subitems.remaining_condition: Pending audit delivery is exposed and must remain visible if signing/delivery fails.

subitems.concrete_outcome: Persist cancellation intent, signal only verified process identity, and count verified surviving jobs after API restart.
acceptance_evidence: Tests cover unconfirmed exit, reused PID refusal, unknown identity and recovered survivor behavior.
subitems.remaining_condition: All OS crash/power-loss schedules and distributed worker ownership are not proven; remaining children prevent confirmed cancellation.

subitems.concrete_outcome: Provide protected start/list/get/artifact/cancel APIs and a bounded saved-list view using existing repository state.
acceptance_evidence: HTTP integration rejects unauthorized access; O15's saved-list follow-up raises unit-file result to 8 passing tests and asserts one repository list load.
The final integrated schema was regenerated in O15 and the reconstructed candidate passed exporter --check; Q1 records this completed gate.
